subject: science
concept: Understanding a food chain as the flow of energy from one living thing to another
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Ecosystems) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student arranges organism cards into a correct food chain order using arrows to show energy flow
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an organism to what it eats and what eats it
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, what a described food chain shows

misconception_flags: draws the arrow backward, reversing the direction of energy flow

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
